tactics:
induction l with
| nil => simp
| cons x xs ih =>
  simp only [List.nodup_cons, ih, List.count_cons]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ b
    by_cases hb : b = x
    · subst hb
      simp [List.count_eq_zero.mpr h1]
    · simp [hb, h2 b]
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun b => ?_⟩
    · have := h x
      have := List.count_pos_iff.mpr hx
      simp at *
      omega
    · have := h b
      split at this <;> omega
